notes: Texts read from sheet 176 of the tournament savegame (card images) on 2026-11-22; the character card is 361 on sheet 3 (10x7, index 61). Sheet 176 is also Medusa's DeckID and the other heroes': the CardIDs repeat and only the deck image tells the decks apart (docs/card-identity.md).

The four TRICK cards are `lent`: every other hero's effects accept them (`HeroEffects.card`), because a TRICK is played by whoever holds it. The LOKI and NOT LOKI parts are told by a condition on the PLAYER's hero (an own hero named Loki), so one entry serves both. Rulings: Ivan 2026-11-22 (LO1-LO4) and docs/heroes/loki.md.
Plugins: loki:swap_values, loki:laevateinn, loki:looking_for_trouble, loki:return_trick (docs/heroes/loki.md). The rest uses ops that already existed.

ability.text:
MISCHIEF-MONGER
After you play a TRICK, put that card into your opponent's hand instead of your discard pile.
If an opponent discards a TRICK from their hand, return that card to your hand or the top of your deck.
Add +1 to your move value for each TRICK in your opponents' hands.
ability.notes: First sentence: the cleanup of a played TRICK is the engine's (`sparring/tricks.py`, called from `inventions.settle_played`): Loki's goes to the opponent's hand, the opponent's to LOKI's discard pile. Second: the engine (`Game.discard_card`) sends the card to Loki's hand at once and this trigger lets Loki move it to the top of his deck instead. Third: the counter `trick_in_rival_hand` of the HeroDef, read by the Maneuver like Sinbad's VOYAGE.

cards.title: Ragnarök
cards.text: This card's effects cannot be canceled. DURING COMBAT: Add +3 to this card's value for each TRICK in your opponent's hand.
cards.notes: Attack 0 / boost 3. Counts the TRICKs the engine tracks in the opponent's hand (a count shows nothing hidden).

cards.title: Shapeshifter
cards.text:
DURING COMBAT: Choose one effect:
- add +1 to this card's value for each card in your opponent's hand
- gain 1 action
cards.notes: Attack 0 / boost 2 (unmatched-memory says 3; the card prints 2). The card count is the opponent's hand when the effect runs.

cards.title: Looking For Trouble
cards.text: IMMEDIATELY: If your opponent played a card, return it to their hand, look at their hand, and choose a card for them to play.
cards.notes: Attack 4 / boost 3. Philippa's Do my bidding with one difference: Loki may also choose a TRICK of the opponent's hand (Ivan 2026-11-22, LO4); a TRICK the opponent plays this way goes to Loki's discard as any played TRICK.

cards.title: Trick: Baldr's Downfall
cards.text: LOKI: AFTER COMBAT: Draw 1 card. NOT LOKI: AFTER COMBAT: Deal 2 damage to your hero.
cards.notes: Attack 4, band ANY, TRICK, boost 0. `hero` is the owner's hero: the player who plays the card takes the 2 damage (the NOT LOKI part).

cards.title: God Of Mischief
cards.text:
IMMEDIATELY: If your opponent played a TRICK, ignore that card's value.
Otherwise, cancel all effects on your opponent's card.
cards.notes: Versatile 2 / boost 3. "Ignore the value" is `set_value ignore` (the total is 0 at that moment; a later BOOST still adds). With no opponent card the `else` finds nothing to cancel.

cards.title: Malicious Flyting
cards.text:
AFTER COMBAT: Draw 1 card.
If your opponent played a TRICK, draw 2 cards instead.

cards.title: Underhanded
cards.text: DURING COMBAT: If your opponent has more cards in their hand than you, this card's value is 6 instead.
cards.notes: Versatile 3 / boost 2. Hands are compared when DURING runs (the card is already out of its owner's hand). `set_value` replaces the printed value, bonuses stay.

cards.title: Laevateinn
cards.text: DURING COMBAT: Reveal a card in your opponent's hand. Add its BOOST value to this card's value. If you reveal a TRICK, put it in your hand.
cards.notes: Versatile 2 / boost 3. Loki chooses the card blind (Ivan 2026-11-22, LO1): a uniform random position, never by hidden information. A revealed TRICK has BOOST 0 and goes to Loki's hand.

cards.title: Trick: Freyja's Rescue
cards.text: LOKI: DURING COMBAT: Swap the values of your card and your opponent's card. NOT LOKI: AFTER COMBAT: Loki recovers 3 health.
cards.notes: Versatile 2, band ANY, TRICK, boost 0. Swap: the running totals of the two cards at that moment (printed value, bonuses and earlier DURING effects); see Pending Ivan.

cards.title: Trick: Sindri's Bet
cards.text: LOKI: DURING COMBAT: Your opponent may discard a card. If they don't, subtract 3 from their card's value. NOT LOKI: AFTER COMBAT: Loki returns the top card of their discard pile to their hand.
cards.notes: Defense 3, band ANY, TRICK, boost 0. LOKI part: the opponent decides to discard a card of their hand or lose 3 from their card (no card to discard: -3; Ivan 2026-11-22, LO3). NOT LOKI part: the top card of LOKI's discard pile returns to Loki's hand; his own card of the combat reaches the pile only after the AFTER, so it is the card that was on top before the combat.

cards.title: Trick: Svadilfari's Lure
cards.text: LOKI: Place an opposing fighter adjacent to Loki. NOT LOKI: Loki reveals a card in your hand. Discard that card.
cards.notes: Scheme, band ANY, TRICK, no printed value. LOKI part: the player places one opposing fighter on an empty space adjacent to Loki. NOT LOKI part: Loki picks a card of the player's hand blind (LO1) and it is discarded: a uniform random card of the hand (a TRICK discarded returns to Loki).

plugins.why: Freyja's Rescue swaps the running values of the two cards of the combat: no op reads one value to write the other.
Laevateinn reveals a blind-picked card of the opponent's hand, adds its BOOST value to the card and, when it is a TRICK, moves it to Loki's hand.
Looking For Trouble: return the opponent's card, look at their hand and choose a card for them to play, a TRICK included (Philippa's do_my_bidding, with the owner of each option).
MISCHIEF-MONGER: the TRICK an opponent discarded is in Loki's hand; Loki may put it on top of his deck instead.

hidden_info.what: Loki picks a position blind (random); the bot never reads the human's hand for it. The human states what the revealed card is.
look_hand: the bot reads the human's hand only when this card says so, at that moment.
A random discard from the hand of the player who plays it (Loki's blind pick).
